sections.description: GRID-Arendal accessibility and optional editorial tools. Configure modules per website; no automatic legacy-content migration or WCAG compliance claim.
sections.changelog: Includes automatic editable ACF starter groups, the GRID-Arendal Field groups interface and protected workspace navigation from 2.0.2. Contains hidden table accessibility labels within the workspace scroll region to prevent page-wide horizontal scrolling on phones. Existing field customisations and native editorial permissions are preserved.
